── Deep Analysis ───────────────────────────────────
We are on the RIGHT side right now: BTC SHORT is aligned with BELOW-EMA300 structure, MARKDOWN wyckoff, and 120/129 aggregate SHORT_BIAS — and it just paid on the overnight dumps (entry 68002 → 67719). The catch is WHERE the entry came from: meta_rsi 19.59 — a short opened at deeply oversold RSI, the exact BANANA wrong-side pattern (shorting oversold = catching the knife's bounce). It is winning only because trend is carrying it, not because the entry was good; a BTC bounce stops this first. That makes the breakeven lock (steer 1) the single highest-value action this cycle: the profit threshold is already touched, so the trade can no longer be the wrong-side kind.

The 24h loss set (14 closes, 6W, net -$0.08) keeps repeating the standing failure mode: 6 of 8 losers never armed (+0.40% MFE). What the winning side looked like — (a) JUP LONG -$0.11 (meta_rsi 35) and IOTA LONG -$0.09: both coins' own 15m regime SHORT_BIAS; SHORT was the winning direction and JUP fell -4.7% against us; (b) BTC LONG @ meta_rsi 88.0: SHORT was the winning side — shorts printed +$0.19/+$0.15 the same day; (c) MNT SHORT @ meta_rsi 74: LONG was the winning side (we shorted strength against the coin's own bullish regime). Why we weren't on it: entries fired against the coin's own regime or at RSI extremes instead of with structure.

jup_yolo_mirrored deep-dive (largest sample, 30d 154T): 61.7% WR but net -$0.99 — avg win +0.066 vs avg loss -0.134 (payoff 0.49:1). All 8 of its 7d losers were never-armed (armed losers: 0), so this is NOT an exit-timing bleed — the entries never reach +0.40% in the first place. The winning side within jup_yolo is the armed subset (winners carry via trail); the losing subset is chop entries that die before trail arms. Same conclusion as the KPI: entry quality owns the bleed.

Direction economics confirmed three ways: auto-trader scorecard shorts 33T 51.5% WR +$0.71 vs longs 25T 36.0% WR +$0.06; 7d SHORT arm rate 52.7% (29/55) vs LONG 42.1% (16/38); every broad 15m regime read is SHORT_BIAS. Longs are the drag; shorts are where the system makes money on this tape.

── Recommendations ─────────────────────────────────
1. Move BTC SHORT 16902 stop 68557 → 68002 (breakeven) NOW — +2% threshold already touched, condition: while 1m closes hold below EMA300 68214. The auto-trader R1 tweak pushing the stop to 68557 re-risked open profit; reverse it.
2. Keep the short, exit on structure reclaim only: EXIT if 1m closes hold above EMA300 68214 for 15-30m — do not exit on a level with no trigger; do not add while BTC 1m flip-rate is at p95 (26/24h).
3. No manual/standalone entries this cycle beyond the watchlist pick: 7d chop-bleed 93.5% (≥92 mandate) means the next entry is statistically a never-armed loser; idle slots are not a cost.
4. Brain-auditor queue (no action by me): (a) jup_yolo_mirrored payoff asymmetry — 154T 61.7% WR net -$0.99, avgL 2.0x avgW, all 7d losers never-armed → is it entry-band or size? (b) counter-own-regime entries (direction vs coin's own 15m regime) over 7d/30d — 3 of 8 24h losers were counter-regime.
5.
